problem_restatement: Decide whether all eighteen frozen prospective MU breakout-pressure onsets support adding MU to the funded successor portfolio without changing the mechanism or opening a new selection loop.

incremental_evidence.interpretation: The three new eligible onsets did not add a resolved outcome; they increased technical censoring and therefore did not strengthen the economic sample.

recommendation.Recommendation: Reject MU as a funded v55 route under the frozen mechanism. The isolated report-only observer may continue collecting evidence, but it is no longer on the immediate successor critical path.
recommendation.Why now: The sample reached eighteen eligible decisions without increasing the eight completed lifecycles; robust after-cost economics remain negative and short evidence remains 0-for-2.
recommendation.Evidence reviewed: The immutable v7 replay, v6 predecessor, exact causal book prefix, venue candles and funding, WebSocket marks, bounded 0xArchive repairs, frozen development identity, and fee evidence.
recommendation.Observed problem or opportunity: MU supplies signal cadence but not technically complete or outlier-robust funded-route evidence.
recommendation.Applicable market regime: Only the prospective MU states represented by the eighteen frozen decisions through the declared cutoff.
recommendation.Alternatives considered: Promote bidirectionally, select the long side post hoc, relax path requirements, continue waiting on the successor critical path, or reject funded routing while leaving collection isolated.
recommendation.Expected upside: Removing MU from the successor critical path prevents an adverse, censored route from delaying evaluation of the stronger independent SPCX candidate.
recommendation.Main risks and failure modes: A later MU sample could improve, but promoting now would rely on one winner, unresolved paths, and a losing short slice.
recommendation.Validation completed: Exact identity, bounded prefixes, fees, funding, friction, both-side attribution, largest-winner removal, censor classification, artifact hashing, and no-authority verification.
recommendation.Validation still required: A future reconsideration requires a new preregistered complete sample, exact source parity, positive both-side stress economics, and positive largest-winner-removed totals without changing the frozen mechanism.
recommendation.Success metrics: Technically resolved lifecycles, positive nominal and stress totals and medians, positive results excluding the largest winner, and supportive evidence on both sides.
recommendation.Failure / rollback triggers: No live change exists to roll back. MU remains rejected while any technical path is unresolved, either side is unsupported, or largest-winner-removed economics are negative.
recommendation.Confidence level: High confidence in arithmetic, identity, and the current no-funded-route decision; medium confidence that the present mechanism lacks repeatable edge; low confidence about permanent MU unprofitability under genuinely different future mechanisms.

single_highest_value_next_investigation: Resolve the frozen SPCX cash-open gap-reversal entry-path evidence and open its sealed validation once only if the unchanged development identity remains supportive.
falsifiers: Any evidence hash, bounded prefix, replay arithmetic, side attribution, or no-authority field fails independent verification.
A future preregistered technically resolved both-side sample becomes positive after exact costs and largest-winner removal.
Source-native candle and L2 decision parity materially changes the reconstructed entries or exits.
The active v53 runtime is shown to have been changed by this report-only replay.
